full_prompt_en: A square naturalistic painting shows the heads of two horses close together against a simple warm gray background. A chestnut horse enters from the left, its long face angled down toward the lower center and a narrow white blaze running from the forehead to the muzzle. One dark eye catches a small reflection beneath a pointed ear, while the short mane along the upper left edge stays mostly in shadow. From the right, a larger pale cream horse leans toward it, its head descending through a curtain of long wavy blond mane. The pale ear stands near the top center, and an eye looks downward just above the dark muzzle. The two noses meet softly near the lower middle, making their contact the quiet focus of the image. The chestnut coat is built from warm brown, russet, and soft gray transitions, with short hair texture visible around the cheek and nose. The cream coat contains ivory, beige, and cool shadowed gray, while individual light strands of the mane catch the upper light. The background remains unobtrusive, darkening near the top and right so the pale animal stands forward. A warm glow reaches the left horse from the lower left, and diffuse light from above shapes the cream mane and both faces; shadows remain soft under the jaws and between the touching muzzles. Edges are sharpest around eyes, ears, and nostrils, then gently lost along the outer coats. The overall composition is close, tender, and restrained, with realistic surface detail serving the calm relationship between the two forms.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形自然主义绘画呈现两匹马的头部在朴素暖灰背景前靠近。栗色马从左侧进入，长脸朝下方中央倾斜，狭窄的白色额斑从额头延伸到口鼻。一只深色眼睛在尖耳下方接住小小反光，左上缘的短鬃大半留在阴影中。右侧一匹更大的浅奶油色马向它靠来，头从长长卷曲的金色鬃发中垂下。浅色耳朵立在上方中央附近，一只眼睛在深色口鼻上方朝下望去。两个鼻端在下方中部轻轻碰到一起，使接触成为画面的安静焦点。栗色皮毛由暖棕、赤褐与柔和灰调过渡建立，面颊和鼻部附近可见短毛肌理。奶油色皮毛含象牙白、米色和冷调阴影灰，鬃发中一根根浅色发丝接住上方光。背景不抢眼，在顶部和右侧加深，让浅色动物向前突出。暖光从左下方碰到左侧马匹，上方漫射光塑造奶油色鬃发和两张面孔；下颌及相触口鼻之间的阴影保持柔软。眼睛、耳朵和鼻孔周围边缘最清晰，外侧皮毛的轮廓则温和地消失。整体构图贴近、温柔而克制，写实表面细节服务于两个形体之间的平静关系。
style_prompt_en: Naturalistic painting relies on finely graded tonal transitions, delicate filament like texture, and selective sharp detail. Warm chestnut, ivory, beige, charcoal, and soft gray balance one another against a subdued neutral field. A pale mass and a darker mass lean inward, concentrating attention at their small point of contact while much of the frame remains quietly uncluttered. Narrow bright accents make reflective details legible, and longer light strands vary the texture of broader smooth planes. Contours sharpen at small focal features but soften into the background along less important edges. Gentle light from above and one low side creates rounded volume without hard theatrical shadows. Matte surfaces retain minute brushed marks and subtle color shifts instead of a glossy finish. The overall effect is intimate and patient, using realism, compressed spacing, and restrained light to convey stillness.
style_prompt_zh: 自然主义绘画依靠细腻渐变的明暗、纤丝般肌理和有选择的锐利细节。暖栗色、象牙白、米色、炭色与柔和灰调在低饱和中性场前互相平衡。一块浅色体量与一块较深体量向内倾斜，将注意力集中在很小的接触点，而画面大部分保持安静、没有杂乱。窄小亮色重音使反光细节可辨，更长的浅色丝状笔迹让宽阔平滑的色面产生肌理变化。细小焦点特征处的轮廓清晰，较不重要的边缘则柔和地融入背景。来自上方与一处较低侧面的温和光线建立圆润体积，却没有生硬的舞台式阴影。哑光表面保留极细的刷痕和微妙色差，而非光亮漆面。整体效果亲密而从容，借写实、紧凑间距和克制照明传达静止感。
theme_en: Two horses touching faces in a softly lit close-up
theme_zh: 两匹马在柔光特写中轻轻碰触面部
name: Bonnie Marris
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
